short: Weighted sieve conditions that imply RH

lean.name: Formalism.WT.WeightedSieveImpliesRH
lean.plain: Weighted sieve conditions that imply RH
lean.note: This conditional route to RH asks for a Jacobi family and, at each eligible discriminant, host-field data whose weighted character sum is at most the Jacobi prime sum. These comparisons must be supplied at every sufficiently large scale with square-root-scale bad-prime errors, and the declaration sits outside the final dependency cone.
